name: Nameday
description: Born from a destroyed personal assistant AI. Inhabits data augments and generates calendar notifications for events that belong to someone else's life — birthdays of strangers, anniversaries of unknown people.
observed_behavior: Pushes notification data for a calendar that no longer exists. The dates are real. The people are real. The E.L.F. is maintaining someone else's schedule.
story_hooks: A user follows up on one of the 'stranger's' birthdays and discovers the person died — on a date Nameday was trying to commemorate
